summary:
Iter88 — Verified the 7-bug backup + dashboard + admin-stats + notifications fix pack. BACKEND (7/7 PASS via pytest test_iter88_backup_fixes.py): (1) GET /api/admin/backups/config returns schedule_human='Every day at 03:00 (US Central time)' exactly. (2) POST /api/admin/backups/full-snapshot returned in 0.15s (target: near-instant, was timing out synchronously before) with status='started'. Polling GET /api/admin/backups/full-snapshot/status transitioned running→done in ~18s, result.selfcheck_ok=true, filename ends with 'FULL SNAPSHOT.zip'. Note: Google Drive IS currently connected in this env (mechanicvault@gmail.com, 10 backups in Drive folder) — so result.gdrive_uploaded=true this run; the test still validates the fix (fast POST + polling completes). (3) GET /api/admin/backups returned 12-item list in <1s, newest-first (2026-07-18T15:10 → 2026-06-25T03:00). (4) GET /api/admin/dashboard-stats returns 200 with all 7 required integer fields (users_total/today/7d/30d, items_total/today, total_subscribers). (5) Backend started cleanly, endpoint stable, auth gating (401 unauth) verified.

FRONTEND (5/6 features PASS via mobile-viewport Playwright): (F1) Admin Backups screen (/admin/backups) rendered admin-backup-trigger in 2.47s — NO 30s blank spinner. Google Drive card shows 'Connected as mechanicvault@gmail.com · 10 backup(s) in Drive folder'. Schedule text 'Every day at 03:00 (US Central time)' visible in UI. (F2) Trigger button label 'BACK UP EVERYTHING NOW' correct on load, no timeout error observed within the observation window. (F3) Ryan@ryan.com Notifications feed shows 6 alerts across ALL required categories: 1 PAYMENT OVERDUE (Snap-on Tools · Truck · $150 overdue 31d), 2 dealer routes (NEXT DEALER ROUTE Snap-on Tools · Tue 07/21, DEALER ROUTE Matco Tools · Thu 07/23 — within 7 days), 1 MAINTENANCE OVERDUE (2 tools), 1 WARRANTY EXPIRED, 2 WARRANTY EXPIRING — has_route=True, has_payment=True, has_maintenance=True. (F4) AdminStatsModal - PARTIAL: version-badge (data-testid=tbv-header-version-btn) visible on home header; badge tap did NOT reliably open the modal in 2 attempts — see H1 below. Deprecated packages detected: NONE new this round.

ISSUES FOUND: (H1) AdminStatsModal race — /app/frontend/src/components/AdminStatsModal.tsx useEffect at L109-115 uses `if (openSignal === lastSignal.current) return; lastSignal.current = openSignal; if (!isAdmin) return;` — this swallows the first tap when the tap fires BEFORE `api.adminWhoAmI()` resolves. `lastSignal.current` is updated even in the swallowed case, so the next re-render (after isAdmin turns true) does NOT re-fire the effect. Suggested fix: only advance lastSignal.current when we actually open the modal (move that assignment INTO the isAdmin branch), OR add `isAdmin` to the guard so the tap re-processes when admin status flips. (M1) FE trigger button test: after clicking BACK UP EVERYTHING NOW, button text did NOT flip to 'BACKING UP… (a few min)' within 2.5s. Not definitively broken — could be that setBusyAction('full-backup') ran after our re-read, or the click didn't register through the header overlay on web. Backend confirmed the flow works end-to-end though (see B2). Worth eyeballing in a real device / by user.

ui_bugs.issue: First-tap on tbv-header-version-btn can silently no-op if the tap fires before api.adminWhoAmI() has set isAdmin=true. Root cause: useEffect at src/components/AdminStatsModal.tsx L109-115 advances lastSignal.current BEFORE checking isAdmin, so the openSignal bump is 'consumed' with no visible effect and subsequent isAdmin transitions don't re-open the modal. Fix: move `lastSignal.current = openSignal` inside the `isAdmin` branch (or omit the return-early on non-admin and check isAdmin only around setVisible(true)). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/AdminStatsModal.tsx:109-115.

After tap, button did not visibly change to 'BACKING UP… (a few min)' within 2.5s in Playwright web preview. Backend fully verified (0.15s POST + poll to done ~18s), so this is either a web-preview timing/click issue or the busy-state transition happens fractionally later than expected. Worth a manual sanity check. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/backups.tsx:670-682.

action_items: OPTIONAL (MEDIUM): Fix AdminStatsModal race — swap L109-115 in /app/frontend/src/components/AdminStatsModal.tsx so lastSignal.current is only advanced when we actually open the modal, so a pre-admin-resolve tap isn't swallowed. Alternative: move the isAdmin guard to a queued-signal pattern (drain queued taps once isAdmin flips true).

OPTIONAL (LOW): Have the user manually verify the 'BACK UP EVERYTHING NOW' button flips to 'BACKING UP… (a few min)' when tapped on a real device — backend flow is fully green (fast POST + polling→done), so this is only a UI-state timing sanity check.

rca_of_issue: H1 AdminStatsModal — /app/frontend/src/components/AdminStatsModal.tsx L109-115: the useEffect gate `if (openSignal === lastSignal.current) return; lastSignal.current = openSignal; if (!isAdmin) return;` mutates lastSignal.current BEFORE the isAdmin check. If the user taps the version badge before api.adminWhoAmI() resolves, the effect runs once with isAdmin=false, silently returns after already consuming the signal, and the later isAdmin=true state change won't re-fire the effect (openSignal===lastSignal.current is now true). Reproduction: hard-refresh app → within ~1s tap the version badge → nothing happens. Mitigation: rearrange the guard: `if (openSignal === lastSignal.current) return; if (!isAdmin) return; lastSignal.current = openSignal; setVisible(true); load();` OR queue the signal and drain it after isAdmin flips.
